name: Kirigakure Saizou
source:
A member of the Sanada ninjas. Formerly an Iga ninja.

He left the Iga clan for personal reasons and sought to make a name for himself by challenging well-known warriors. After dueling Nobushige Sanada and Sasuke Sarutobi, he joined the Sanada ninjas. He is confident in both swordsmanship and ninja arts, and often resorts to ruthless tactics to fulfill his goals. His ultimate goal is to rise as a samurai, preferring the sword to ninja tools.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/homura/chara/?page=saizou]Idea Factory International[/url]]
